_schema: THE ONLY place a sponsor's company website or benefits-guide link may live. Keyed by EIN (9 digits, no dash) because one company files several plans and they share one website. Every link carries `asOf` (the date it was verified), `method` ("fetched" = the page was read; "search" = an index described it and the host was unreachable) and `evidence` (the quote or result that convinced you). A benefits link over TWO YEARS old FAILS the checker: a benefits guide is a dated artifact and the motivating example is an annual-enrolment microsite replaced every autumn. `coversYear` is the guide's own stated year where it states one; `gated: true` marks a login portal a reader cannot open. Written by the company-links agent (.claude/agents/company-links.md), validated by scripts/company-links-check.mjs. NOT a filed fact -- this is the first curated field since data.js, and data.js is on record as going stale.
_network: EVERY entry below is method "search". In a cloud session curl returns http=000 bytes=0 and WebFetch returns ENOTFOUND for all of these hosts: the egress policy allows the EFAST2 bucket and the search tool and little else. http=000 is a report on the QUERY, not a fact about the company -- it must never be read as "the site is down". Liveness belongs on a GitHub runner, which has open outbound network, or in a session whose network settings allow these hosts.
